subject: bauhausBird
pitch:
Category: Animal.
Subject: songbird on a branch.
Style: Bauhaus primary-colour geometry.

requests.what: Paint a crisp Bauhaus fan pattern on the left blue wing: three broad nested geometric bands in BLUE, RED, and YELLOW, with clean black separators and no shading.
Mirror the Bauhaus fan pattern on the right wing using BLUE, RED, and YELLOW, keeping the wing silhouette clear and the graphic shapes broad.
Add a simple graphic belly treatment: a large YELLOW oval panel on the front underside, bordered by a thin BLACK ring, leaving the BLUE body visible around it.
Add a small RED and YELLOW geometric cheek emblem on both sides of the head, like two overlapping Bauhaus circles, placed behind the eyes.
Paint the branch in alternating WOOD and WOOD_LIGHT angular bark bands, with a few short BLACK seam marks following the branch direction.
Three small triangular tail-tip pennants in RED, YELLOW, and WHITE, attached across the rear feather fan.
A jaunty Bauhaus crown feather: one short RED diamond blade with a smaller YELLOW diamond inset, rising from the top of the head.
Two small BLACK and YELLOW geometric bands around the orange legs just above the feet, one matching band per leg.
Two simple flat GREEN leaves on short brown stems, one leaf near each end of the branch, kept well away from the bird silhouette.
